# getthatone.co.uk

> Independent top 10 buying guides. Per product type ten models compared on specs, price and reviews, with pros and cons, a buying guide and FAQ. Prices are indicative reference prices.

getthatone is run by Nick van Straaten, an independent publisher based in the Netherlands. For each product type we compare models on specs, price and buyer reviews, and we update a guide when prices change or a better model comes out. We don't test products in a lab ourselves. Our guides are written with the help of AI tools, based on manufacturer specs, prices and buyer reviews; Nick oversees the method and corrects guides when readers or our own checks find a mistake. Contact: nick@4neon.nl

## Main pages

- [getthatone](https://getthatone.co.uk/): Independent top 10 buying guides: the best TVs, robot vacuums, air fryers and more of 2026. Compared on price, specs and reviews.
- [All guides](https://getthatone.co.uk/all-guides.html): Overview of all top 10 buying guides on getthatone, filterable by category.
- [How we choose](https://getthatone.co.uk/how-we-choose.html): How we rank products: a score from 1 to 10 for performance, value, reliability and ease of use, based on specs, prices and buyer reviews. No lab tests.
- [About us](https://getthatone.co.uk/about-us.html): getthatone publishes independent top 10 buying guides, run by Nick van Straaten from the Netherlands. No paid rankings: brands cannot buy a spot in our lists.
- [Gifts](https://getthatone.co.uk/gifts/): Gift ideas for 2026: the number 1 from each of our top 10 guides, chosen on specs, price and buyer reviews.
- [Buying quiz](https://getthatone.co.uk/buying-quiz.html): Answer three questions and find out which product from our top 10 guides best fits your budget and needs.
- [Best value](https://getthatone.co.uk/best-value.html): For every product type, the model with the best value for money from our top 10 guides.
